answer: A single fake is a craft project; a hundred is an industry. Tailor apprenticeship certificate with tailors guild attestation makes the industry visible: four-year apprenticeship, 5,000 supervised hours, master review, guild dues. The island is the factory floor — the supervisors, the stamps, the histories, each needing its own room. Each unit needs its own supervisor and its own paper trail, and the echo is the floor manager: one person coordinating lies full-time, leaving a trail in every ledger they touch. The bridge is the pattern across all hundred, which the checker sees at once.
